title: Countdown component data
description: Countdown to an instant. targetAt is the target time in epoch ms (it cannot be cleared once set); the other keys style the card. Members may edit the countdown fields in run mode only when runEditable is true (default false); owner and admin always may, and only they may change runEditable itself.

v.description: Wire format version, written by the app. Absent means 1.

targetAt.description: Target time in epoch milliseconds. Cannot be cleared once set. Example: 1798761600000. Members may change it only when runEditable is true; owner and admin always may.

what.description: Label of the event being counted down to. Example: "Holiday". Members may change it only when runEditable is true; owner and admin always may.

style.description: Colour preset of the card: ember, amber, punch, lagoon, iris, fern, dusk or slate. Members may change it only when runEditable is true; owner and admin always may.

emoji.description: Sticker shown on the card. '' means none. Example: "🎉". Members may change it only when runEditable is true; owner and admin always may.

precision.description: Smallest unit shown: auto, days, hours, minutes or seconds. Members may change it only when runEditable is true; owner and admin always may.

size.description: Card size: small, medium or large. Members may change it only when runEditable is true; owner and admin always may.

runEditable.description: When true, members may edit the countdown fields in run mode. Default false. Only owner and admin may change this flag.

customColor.description: ARGB colour as an integer, overriding style. null clears it. Example: 4294198070. Members may change it only when runEditable is true; owner and admin always may.

_title.description: Panel title shown above the component. '' clears it. Example: "Groceries".

_sectionBreak.description: true starts a new visual section, with a bigger gap above and a stronger separator.

_width.description: Preferred width in logical pixels. Default 600, minimum 300.

_spaceAbove.description: Legacy spacing above in pixels, no longer written. When _sectionBreak is absent, a value of 16 or more reads as a section break.

_spaceBelow.description: Legacy spacing below in pixels, no longer written.

^_.description: Other layout and UI keys starting with _. Any value.
